text: ghatvāsuttaṃ [943] ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme . atha kho sakko devānamindo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi . [944] ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho sakko devānamindo bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi kiṃsu ghatvā 1 sukhaṃ seti kiṃsu ghatvā na socati kissassa 2 ekadhammassa vadhaṃ rocesi gotamāti . [945] kodhaṃ ghatvā sukhaṃ seti kodhaṃ ghatvā na socati kodhassa visamūlassa madhuraggassa vāsava vadhaṃ ariyā pasaṃsanti taṃ hi ghatvā na socatīti . dutiyaṃ
